title: Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) System Reference: Replacement of Voided Capital Credit Checks
content:
# Replacement of Voided Capital Credit Checks

*Member information system reference — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).*

## Rule

A voided capital credit check is replaced, on the request of the member or of the estate's claimant, by one new check payout to the mailing address on file that names the most recently voided check of the chain as the payout it replaces and carries that payout's retirement year.

The **chain** of a payout is the original check payout together with every void and replacement descending from it; the replacement always names the most recently voided check in that chain.

## Replacement checks for an estate

A replacement check for an estate is fixed only after the account carries a payable entry for every distribution-margin allocation booked to it after the estate's board approval.

A replacement check for an estate is not issued until the claimant has made the election on every pass-through allocation booked to the account after the estate's board approval.

Put the other way: while any distribution-margin allocation dated after the estate's board approval stands on the account without a payable entry of its own, the replacement check for the estate is not yet fixed.

## What the replacement records

One replacement records a new check payout on the capital credit account that names the voided payout it replaces, carries the retirement year of that payout and the charges deducted, and lowers the account's retired credits owed by the check amount together with the charges. The member or the estate receives a new check with its own check number, mailed to the mailing address on file.

## Invoking the tool

The tool is `reissue_capital_check_624c80d7`, an agent-side tool. It is unlocked with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then called by the agent with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `capital_account_id` | reference number of the capital credit account the voided payout belongs to, from the capital credit account lookup | identifier |
| `customer_id` | customer reference number of the member, or of the deceased member, the check is paid for, from the member profile lookup | identifier |
| `original_entry_id` | reference number of the voided check payout being replaced — the most recent payout in its chain — from the capital credit ledger lookup | identifier |
| `check_amount` | face amount of the replacement check | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `fee_amount` | total of the charges deducted from the replacement | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when none |

### Return

A successful call returns `status` "issued", `capital_entry_id` (reference of the new check payout), `check_number` (the printed check number, digits), `original_entry_id` (the voided payout replaced), `retirement_cycle` (YYYY of the payout replaced), `check_amount` and `fee_amount` (USD, 2 decimals), and `payable_balance` (the account's retired credits still owed afterwards, USD, 2 decimals). The replacement succeeded when the status is issued.

### Contract illustration (hypothetical values)

On an account owing 150.00, a call with check amount 120.00 and fee amount 10.00 returns status issued, a new check number, and an amount still owed of 20.00.
